name: theme-shuffle
description:
Animated backdrops that shuffle every few minutes, the same in every session. Each theme has a calm sound. Includes Snowdrift: snow piles up as your context fills.

Commands (/theme-shuffle …):
• (nothing): show status
• list: pick a theme on a card
• now: switch right away
• hold: keep the current theme
• on | off: start or stop
• 10: switch every 10 minutes
• light | dark | all: which themes
• snowdrift: jump to a theme by name
